name: Tsofeer Cavern
summary: Tsofeer Cavern is a delve in Murkmire, located southwest of Dead-Water Village, containing swamp wildlife. The cave is rumored to have been the last known location of the Ninth Imperial Legion before it disappeared under mysterious circumstances. The cave is also home to the Wuju-Ka, a massive and powerful voriplasm that has been sealed inside by the local tribes of Murkmire going back generations, to avoid it being released and causing havoc in the region.
notes: NPC versions of the Gas Blossom plants found throughout Murkmire can be found within the cave. They act in the exact same way, despite being NPCs, as since they are friendly, they cannot be attacked from afar.
Some of the voriplasms inside can be seen consuming dead salamanders and even alive haj mota. However, upon starting combat, the haj mota fall over dead.
In the last two chambers of the cave, large stretchy sections of green slime can be seen on the walls and ceilings, possibly being parts of the Wuju-Ka itself.
This location is a good place to farm voriplasms for the Voriplasm Slayer achievement, as a large amount of them can be found all in close proximity to each other in the last two rooms of the cave.
